title: Towns change hands
changes: Saltmere, Rustwater Post, Ropewell and Millbrook Mill now follow the land around them. When that land changes hands, the town is contested for about 30 minutes and its old guard stands at the gate.
Sworn heroes of the new clan can cut down the guard and raise their clan's banner at the gate. Without a claim, the town passes to the new holder when the time runs out.
Gate guards are at least level 15, even at Millbrook Mill. They only fight heroes of level 12 and above, and only those heroes can hurt them. Nobody can strike them from inside the town.
Each clan has its own steward, with a new name and voice in every town it holds.
Heroes sworn to a town's holder pay 10% less in its shops. Shops, quests and safe squares stay the same for everyone.
